examples.title: Move the selected image without modifying the source
examples.code:
# Insert a Transform after the selected node and move the image.
source = nuke.selectedNode()

transform = nuke.createNode("Transform")
transform.setInput(0, source)
transform["translate"].setValue(100, 0)
transform["translate"].setValue(50, 1)

examples.title: Animate horizontal position
examples.code:
# Animate the X component of translate from frame 1 to 50.
transform = nuke.createNode("Transform")
translate = transform["translate"]

translate.setAnimated(0)
translate.setValueAt(0, 1, 0)
translate.setValueAt(500, 50, 0)

examples.title: Link rotation to another Transform
examples.code:
# Drive this node's rotation from Transform1.
driven = nuke.createNode("Transform")
driven["rotate"].setExpression("Transform1.rotate")
